lcc_original: 過了那七天，洪流的水就氾濫在地上了。
notes: LCC rephrases UNV's 洪水 as 洪流的水 — H03999 (מַבּוּל, flood) attached to 洪流, H04325 (מַיִם, waters) attached to 水, reflecting the Hebrew construct chain מֵי הַמַּבּוּל.
就 (emphasis/sequential adverb) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
了 (sentence-final aspectual particle) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
Both {<WAH01961>} markers remain implicit: 過了 is a temporal idiom for וַיְהִי ('and it came to pass'), not a literal rendering of H01961; the second occurrence likewise has no explicit copula in LCC.
